sermon.title: Spiritual Evolution - October 6, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: There are no transitional species, but Christians must evolve into new creatures. In perilous last days, turn from sin; God shows no partiality, light has come, and we put on the new man by hearing and doing His word and abiding in the Vine.
